entries.name: Goblin
entries.desc: Small, wiry, and mean. Goblins fight in gangs, throw whatever is at hand, and flee the moment a fight turns fair.
entries.weakness: Cowardly — drop one and the rest must be rallied or they scatter. Easily baited into traps.
entries.tactics: Swarm, stab, run. Never fight goblins where they picked the ground.
entries.art: a snarling goblin with a rusty knife, fantasy creature concept art, dark background

entries.name: Kobold
entries.desc: Dog-faced tunnel dwellers who worship dragons and build vicious little traps.
entries.weakness: Sunlight dazzles them — advantage on your side in daylight. Brittle morale.
entries.tactics: They soften you with traps before showing themselves. Watch the floor.
entries.art: a small dog-faced kobold with a spear in a tunnel, fantasy creature concept art

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.desc: Bones given hateful motion. They feel no pain, no fear, and no fatigue.
entries.weakness: Bludgeoning weapons shatter them — a club beats a rapier here. Holy power turns them.
entries.tactics: They obey their maker literally. Break the maker's hold and they collapse.
entries.art: an animated skeleton warrior with a notched sword, fantasy undead concept art

entries.name: Giant Rat
entries.desc: A rat the size of a dog, bold with hunger. Where there is one there are twelve.
entries.weakness: Fire and loud noise panic them. Their bites fester — clean wounds after.
entries.tactics: They go for the ankles and retreat into walls. Deny them the shadows.
entries.art: a giant rat with matted fur baring teeth in a sewer, creature concept art

entries.name: Giant Spider
entries.desc: A patient horror of the dark canopy. You will walk into the web before you see it.
entries.weakness: Fire burns webs and terrifies it. Poison must bite skin — armor helps.
entries.tactics: It strikes from above and retreats. Cut the anchor lines and it falls.
entries.art: a giant black spider descending from a web in a dark forest, fantasy creature art

entries.name: Slime
entries.desc: A creeping ooze that digests everything it touches, slowly and without malice.
entries.weakness: Fire and cold. Never strike it with a metal weapon you want to keep — the acid eats edges.
entries.tactics: It cannot chase you. It wins only if you are careless or cornered.
entries.art: a green acidic slime dissolving a sword on a dungeon floor, fantasy creature art

entries.name: Street Thug
entries.desc: Muscle for hire, loyal to whoever paid last. Dangerous mostly in numbers and dark alleys.
entries.weakness: No stomach for a real fight — real resistance or a named gang boss's displeasure sends them off.
entries.tactics: They surround and intimidate first. Break the circle early.
entries.art: a street thug in a hooded jacket with a bat, gritty urban concept art

entries.name: Scav Drone
entries.desc: A junk-built quadcopter with a taser sting, patrolling territory nobody legally owns.
entries.weakness: EMP, water, thrown nets — anything that fouls rotors. Predictable patrol loops.
entries.tactics: It calls its owner before it attacks. Kill the signal, then the drone.
entries.art: a battered surveillance drone with a taser, cyberpunk concept art, neon

entries.name: Orc
entries.desc: Broad-shouldered raiders who believe a good death beats a long life.
entries.weakness: Pride — an orc accepts single combat and honors it. Slow to change plans mid-fight.
entries.tactics: The first charge is the worst. Survive it and they get sloppy.
entries.art: a fierce orc warrior with a jagged axe, fantasy concept art, war paint

entries.name: Bandit
entries.desc: Road-wolves in human shape. They want your purse, not your life — usually.
entries.weakness: Greed — coin or a bigger score can end the fight without blood. They fear named lawmen.
entries.tactics: Archers stay hidden until the talking fails. Count the shadows first.
entries.art: a masked bandit with a crossbow on a forest road, fantasy concept art

entries.name: Cultist
entries.desc: Ordinary faces hiding extraordinary devotion. The robes come out after dark.
entries.weakness: Fanatics crumble when their icon or leader falls. Disrupting the ritual disrupts them.
entries.tactics: They fight to buy time for something worse. Ask what the delay is for.
entries.art: a hooded cultist with a ritual dagger and glowing sigils, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Zombie
entries.desc: The walking dead — slow, relentless, and utterly without self-preservation.
entries.weakness: Fire and radiant power. Slow — you can simply outpace them. Destroy the head.
entries.tactics: They never stop. Fights you can't win fast are fights to walk away from.
entries.art: a shambling zombie in torn clothes reaching forward, horror fantasy art

entries.name: Ghoul
entries.desc: Grave-lean and quick, with a paralytic touch and an appetite for the living.
entries.weakness: Radiant power sears them; elves shrug off their paralysis. Frenzy makes them reckless.
entries.tactics: One touch can lock you rigid while it feeds. Never let it corner you alone.
entries.art: a gaunt ghoul with long claws crouched over a grave, horror fantasy concept art

entries.name: Wolf
entries.desc: The valley's grey hunters. Not evil — just hungry, clever, and many.
entries.weakness: Fire and a standing fight they didn't choose. Wound the pack leader and the rest reconsider.
entries.tactics: They circle to flank; back against a tree or wall and their advantage dies.
entries.art: a grey wolf snarling in moonlit snow, wildlife fantasy concept art

entries.name: Hobgoblin
entries.desc: Goblin-kin with discipline — soldiers where goblins are looters.
entries.weakness: They fight by doctrine; break formation with chaos, terrain, or fire and they must regroup.
entries.tactics: Shield walls and volleys. Take the officer and the line wavers.
entries.art: a disciplined hobgoblin soldier in lamellar armor with a longsword, fantasy art

entries.name: Gang Enforcer
entries.desc: Chromed muscle with a reputation to maintain and a boss to impress.
entries.weakness: Their implants need power and calibration — EMP and dirty fighting. Face means everything; humiliation cuts deeper than blades.
entries.tactics: They telegraph big hits to look good. The show is the opening.
entries.art: a cybernetic gang enforcer with a chrome arm, neon-lit alley, cyberpunk art

entries.name: Combat Drone
entries.desc: Corporate security on rotors: sensors, a gun, and no one to talk down.
entries.weakness: EMP, hacking, sensor-blinding smoke. It obeys its no-fire zones even when you don't.
entries.tactics: It holds range. Close fast, break line of sight, or blind it.
entries.art: a sleek armed corporate security drone, red sensor eye, cyberpunk concept art

entries.name: Ogre
entries.desc: Nine feet of appetite and bad temper swinging a tree for a club.
entries.weakness: Dim and single-minded — feints, taunts, and terrain beat muscle. Slow to turn.
entries.tactics: Never trade blows. Make it lunge, then punish the miss.
entries.art: a massive ogre with a tree-trunk club in a stone pass, fantasy concept art

entries.name: Troll
entries.desc: A lank green horror that heals as fast as you can cut it.
entries.weakness: FIRE or ACID — nothing else stops the regeneration. Wounds sealed by flame stay sealed.
entries.tactics: Without fire you cannot win, only delay. Carry a torch or carry regrets.
entries.art: a lanky regenerating troll with claws in a swamp, dark fantasy concept art

entries.name: Owlbear
entries.desc: A bear's bulk with an owl's temper — territorial beyond all reason.
entries.weakness: It defends territory, not honor: leave its ground and it rarely follows far.
entries.tactics: The hug kills more hunters than the beak. Never let it close its arms.
entries.art: an owlbear rearing in a moonlit forest clearing, fantasy creature concept art

entries.name: Stone Golem
entries.desc: A statue that decided to disagree with you. Immune to fear, poison, and persuasion.
entries.weakness: Blunt force cracks stone; blades skate off. It obeys its instructions to the letter — find the letter.
entries.tactics: It is slow and literal. Fighting it is optional; outsmarting it usually isn't.
entries.art: a massive stone golem with glowing runes awakening in a ruin, fantasy art

entries.name: Wyvern
entries.desc: A dragon's meaner cousin: two legs, two wings, and a scorpion sting full of venom.
entries.weakness: The wing membranes tear — ranged fire grounds it, and grounded it loses half its menace.
entries.tactics: It stings on the dive and climbs away. Deny it the sky or deny it you.
entries.art: a wyvern diving with tail stinger extended, stormy sky, fantasy concept art

entries.name: Young Dragon
entries.desc: Even young, it is fire, armor, wings, and a mind older than your grandfather's grudges.
entries.weakness: Vanity and greed — dragons parley when flattered and bargain over treasure. The breath must recharge; count the beats.
entries.tactics: After the breath comes the window. Everything before that is survival.
entries.art: a young red dragon breathing fire in a mountain lair over gold, epic fantasy art

entries.name: Demon
entries.desc: Malice given form and loosed on the world through someone's very bad idea.
entries.weakness: Radiant power, holy water, and its TRUE NAME — named, it can be commanded or banished.
entries.tactics: It lies as easily as it breathes. Every bargain has a hook inside.
entries.art: a horned demon wreathed in hellfire and shadow, dark fantasy concept art

entries.name: Minotaur
entries.desc: Bull-headed fury that never forgets a scent or forgives a trespass.
entries.weakness: It charges in straight lines — sidestep at the last breath and let walls do your work.
entries.tactics: In its maze it is death. Draw it into open ground and the maze stops helping.
entries.art: a minotaur with a great axe in a torchlit labyrinth, fantasy concept art

entries.name: Security Mech
entries.desc: Two tons of corporate liability protection with a public-address system and autocannons.
entries.weakness: Joints and sensors — the armor is for shareholders. Its rules of engagement can be lawyered: no valid threat, no fire.
entries.tactics: It announces before it engages. That announcement is your head start.
entries.art: a hulking corporate security mech in a neon plaza, warning lights, cyberpunk art

entries.name: Stirge
entries.desc: A bat-winged bloodsucker the size of a crow. It attaches, drinks, and detaches heavier.
entries.weakness: Once latched it stops defending itself — a flat blade or a hard slap ends it.
entries.tactics: They dive from cave ceilings in flights of six. Listen for the whine.
entries.art: a bat-winged mosquito creature with a needle proboscis in a cave, fantasy art

entries.name: Twig Blight
entries.desc: A dead shrub with a grudge, animated by corrupted root-magic. They stand still until you pass.
entries.weakness: Tinder-dry — a single flame spreads through a whole thicket of them.
entries.tactics: They ambush in numbers near the thing that made them. Find the root.
entries.art: a small twisted humanoid made of dead branches with ember eyes, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Shadow
entries.desc: A patch of darkness that remembers being a person. Its touch drains the strength from your arms.
entries.weakness: Bright light makes it sluggish; radiant power burns it away entirely.
entries.tactics: It hides inside YOUR shadow and strikes when the torch gutters. Keep two light sources.
entries.art: a humanoid shadow with reaching fingers sliding along a torchlit wall, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Giant Bat
entries.desc: A leather-winged cave dweller with a wingspan like a door. Mostly hungry, rarely brave.
entries.weakness: Loud sharp noise scrambles its echo-sense — a struck shield buys you a free swing.
entries.tactics: It swoops in the dark where you swing blind. Force it to land and it waddles.
entries.art: a giant bat swooping through a torchlit cavern, fantasy creature art

entries.name: Giant Centipede
entries.desc: An arm-long skitterer whose bite numbs flesh. It likes bedrolls and boots.
entries.weakness: Slow to turn — step past the head and the body is just a target.
entries.tactics: It strikes once and waits for the venom. Do not sit down to rest.
entries.art: a giant venomous centipede on dungeon stones, fantasy creature art

entries.name: Biting Sprite Swarm
entries.desc: A cloud of thumb-sized fey with needle teeth and a mob's courage.
entries.weakness: Smoke disperses them; an offering of anything shiny can buy passage outright.
entries.tactics: A thousand small cuts and stolen buckles. Protect your eyes and your coin.
entries.art: a swarm of tiny glowing fey with sharp teeth in a moonlit glade, fantasy art

entries.name: Zombie Hound
entries.desc: Someone's loyal dog, still guarding a master long dead. It does not tire and does not flinch.
entries.weakness: No mind to trick but no judgment either — it chases whatever moved last.
entries.tactics: It bites and holds. A held zombie hound is a free hit for your ally.
entries.art: an undead hound with matted fur and exposed ribs in a graveyard, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Gutter Drake
entries.desc: A cat-sized dragonkin that nests in chimneys and hoards cutlery. Vain, greedy, breath the size of a candle.
entries.weakness: Flattery and shiny tribute turn it from pest to informant — drakes see everything.
entries.tactics: It goes for the eyes, then the pouch. Hold your cloak up like a wall.
entries.art: a small scruffy dragon the size of a cat perched on a rooftop hoarding spoons, fantasy art

entries.name: Razor Gull Flock
entries.desc: Seabirds gone wrong — beaks like shears, appetite like debt. Docks fear them more than storms.
entries.weakness: They will always take thrown food over a fight.
entries.tactics: They strike in relays so you are always flinching. Get under cover and count to twenty.
entries.art: a flock of vicious gulls with blade-like beaks over a harbor, fantasy art

entries.name: Riot Drone
entries.desc: Municipal crowd-control that never got decommissioned. It still enforces a curfew nobody remembers.
entries.weakness: Its threat-response tree is public record — walk slowly, hands visible, and it idles.
entries.tactics: Strobe, siren, taser, in that order. Break line of sight between strobe and siren.
entries.art: a hovering riot-control drone with a crackling taser, cyberpunk concept art

entries.name: Chrome Rat
entries.desc: Vermin that gnaw cabling for the copper taste. Their teeth are grown from scavenged alloy.
entries.weakness: Magnet traps. Their own teeth betray them.
entries.tactics: They chew your gear before they chew you. Hang your pack off the floor.
entries.art: a rat with metallic teeth chewing neon cable in a dark alley, cyberpunk art

entries.name: Script Kiddie
entries.desc: A bored teenager with borrowed exploits and no sense of consequence. Dangerous to your accounts, not your body.
entries.weakness: Vanity — they sign their work. Praise the wrong hack loudly and they will claim it in public.
entries.tactics: They attack your accounts, locks, and reputation from a couch. Unplug what matters.
entries.art: a hooded teen bathed in monitor glow surrounded by energy drink cans, cyberpunk art

entries.name: Guard Dog
entries.desc: Seventy pounds of professional suspicion behind a chain-link fence.
entries.weakness: It is doing a job, not holding a grudge — most stand down when you leave the yard.
entries.tactics: It announces you to everyone, then keeps you cornered until backup comes.
entries.art: a barking guard dog straining against a chain in a floodlit yard, realistic art

entries.name: Pickpocket
entries.desc: Quick fingers and a forgettable face. You will remember the bump, later, at the worst time.
entries.weakness: They cannot afford attention — a loud, clear accusation ends the game instantly.
entries.tactics: One distracts, one lifts, one walks it away. The thief is never holding the goods.
entries.art: a nimble pickpocket slipping a wallet from a coat in a crowded market, concept art

entries.name: Furious Swarm
entries.desc: Ten thousand stings with one opinion about you being here.
entries.weakness: Smoke calms them; water breaks pursuit. They defend a home — leave and they relent.
entries.tactics: They target the face and hands. Cover up and walk, do not swat and run.
entries.art: a dense swarm of angry bees pouring from a hollow tree, realistic art

entries.name: Bugbear
entries.desc: A hulking goblinoid that moves like a whisper. The first you learn of one is the club.
entries.weakness: Lazy at heart — a long chase or a hard fight and it decides you are not worth the wage.
entries.tactics: Ambush, one massive blow, then judge. Never walk point under trees.
entries.art: a hulking bugbear with a spiked club lurking in shadow, fantasy creature art

entries.name: Gnoll
entries.desc: Hyena-headed raiders that laugh while they work. Hunger is their whole theology.
entries.weakness: No discipline to rally — turn their charge once and it becomes a rout.
entries.tactics: They run prey to exhaustion. Do not flee in a straight line; make them turn.
entries.art: a cackling hyena-headed gnoll with a spear on a burnt plain, fantasy art

entries.name: Wight
entries.desc: A dead warrior who kept the ambition. Its sword arm remembers; its touch steals life itself.
entries.weakness: Sunlight sears it; silvered and magic weapons bite where steel skates.
entries.tactics: It raises what it kills. Drop it first or fight your own dead friends.
entries.art: an armored undead warrior with cold blue eyes and a longsword, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Specter
entries.desc: Rage without a body. It pours through walls and reaches through armor.
entries.weakness: Only magic touches it; daylight makes it timid. It cannot leave the place it haunts.
entries.tactics: It attacks through floors and ceilings. The room's history says where it will not go.
entries.art: a translucent screaming spirit passing through a stone wall, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Harpy
entries.desc: A carrion singer with a voice that pulls sailors off decks and climbers off cliffs.
entries.weakness: Block your ears — wax, cloth, a companion's shout — and she is just a slow bird.
entries.tactics: The song draws you to a fall. Rope yourself before the cliffs answer back.
entries.art: a harpy with ragged wings singing on a sea cliff at dusk, fantasy art

entries.name: Mimic
entries.desc: A predator shaped like whatever you most want to open. The lid is the mouth.
entries.weakness: It cannot resist holding still to keep the lie — a thrown rock tests any chest for free.
entries.tactics: It grips with adhesive flesh and chews. Fight with reach, never with your hands.
entries.art: a treasure chest revealing rows of teeth and a long tongue, fantasy art

entries.name: Gelatinous Cube
entries.desc: A corridor-shaped digestive system, nearly invisible until the bones float past.
entries.weakness: It is slower than a nervous walk. Its shape betrays it — corridors only.
entries.tactics: It wants you to back into it while watching something else. Check both ways.
entries.art: a translucent cube filling a dungeon corridor with bones suspended inside, fantasy art

entries.name: Rust Monster
entries.desc: A harmless-looking insectoid that eats worked metal. Your sword, your mail, your legacy blade.
entries.weakness: It has no interest in flesh — drop a cheap dagger and walk away rich.
entries.tactics: The antennae are the danger. Wood, stone, and fists win this fight with dignity.
entries.art: an insectoid creature with feathery antennae corroding a sword, fantasy art

entries.name: Cockatrice
entries.desc: A rooster-lizard whose peck turns flesh to stone, one joint at a time.
entries.weakness: It is a panicky animal — loud noise routs it. The petrification fades if you survive.
entries.tactics: It flaps at your face. A shield high and a friend behind ends it quickly.
entries.art: a rooster-headed lizard with bat wings pecking at a stone hand, fantasy art

entries.name: Basilisk
entries.desc: Eight legs, lazy hunger, and a gaze that makes statues of the curious.
entries.weakness: Its own reflection is fatal to it — a polished shield is both armor and weapon.
entries.tactics: Fight it looking at the floor, tracking its shadow. It is slow; your nerve is the battle.
entries.art: an eight-legged reptile with glowing eyes among stone statues, fantasy art

entries.name: Wererat
entries.desc: A curse that likes cities. By day a fence or ferryman; by night, whiskers and knives.
entries.weakness: Silver, and the fear of exposure — their whole power is nobody knowing.
entries.tactics: They fight dirty in sewers they mapped. Never follow one below street level.
entries.art: a rat-headed humanoid with a dagger in a sewer tunnel, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Werewolf
entries.desc: The village's kindest face, three nights a month excepted. The curse hunts what the person loves.
entries.weakness: Silver burns; wolfsbane repels; the human inside can sometimes be reached by name.
entries.tactics: It stalks first, panics prey, then runs them down. Stand still and speak.
entries.art: a werewolf mid-transformation under a full moon at a farm fence, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Gargoyle
entries.desc: Architecture with malice. It has been watching you since the courtyard.
entries.weakness: Patient but literal — it guards a THING, and moving away from the thing ends pursuit.
entries.tactics: It dives, rakes, and returns to a perch you cannot reach. Fight indoors.
entries.art: a stone gargoyle unfurling its wings on a cathedral ledge at night, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Animated Armor
entries.desc: An empty suit that remembers its drills. It guards doors for masters dead a century.
entries.weakness: It follows its last order exactly. Learn the order and you can walk right past.
entries.tactics: Tireless, fearless, mindless. Bludgeon the joints; there is nothing inside to stab.
entries.art: an empty suit of plate armor standing guard with a halberd, fantasy art

entries.name: Phase Spider
entries.desc: A spider that steps sideways out of the world and back in behind you.
entries.weakness: It must be HERE to bite — the half-second after it appears is your whole fight.
entries.tactics: It blinks, bites, blinks away. Stand back to back and swing on the shimmer.
entries.art: a pale spider phasing between dimensions with a shimmer, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Ankheg
entries.desc: A plow-sized burrower that erupts under wagons and drags the ox down whole.
entries.weakness: Fresh meat staked fifty paces off is cheaper than a fight. Stillness hides you — it hunts vibration.
entries.tactics: It sprays acid when bloodied, then retreats underground. Deny it the retreat hole.
entries.art: a chitinous burrowing insect monster erupting from a farm field, fantasy art

entries.name: Hellhound
entries.desc: A coal-black hound that breathes fire and hunts by the smell of fear.
entries.weakness: It is a hound: commands in its master's voice confuse it, and cold quenches its breath.
entries.tactics: The pack herds you toward the fire of the biggest one. Go where the smoke is not.
entries.art: a black hound with burning eyes breathing fire in the dark, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Imp
entries.desc: A knee-high devil with a poison sting and a lawyer's heart. It offers help. Decline.
entries.weakness: Bound by its contract's exact words — read them aloud and it must comply.
entries.tactics: It turns invisible and whispers ruin into the leader's ear. Ask WHO advised the bad plan.
entries.art: a small horned devil with bat wings and a barbed tail grinning, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Wrathful Dryad
entries.desc: The forest's grief given form. She does not hate you; she hates what your axe implies.
entries.weakness: Genuine amends — planted, watered, sworn — end the fight better than fire ever could.
entries.tactics: The trees themselves hold you while she speaks the sentence. Drop the axe first.
entries.art: a dryad with bark skin and blazing green eyes among grasping roots, fantasy art

entries.name: Cyberhound
entries.desc: A guard dog rebuilt for the balance sheet: titanium jaw, thermal eyes, no off switch you can reach.
entries.weakness: Its IFF chip trusts anyone broadcasting the house code. Steal the code, walk untouched.
entries.tactics: It announces nothing — first warning is the jaw. Watch for the eye-glow in vents.
entries.art: a cybernetic attack dog with a titanium jaw and red thermal eyes, cyberpunk art

entries.name: Razorgang Enforcer
entries.desc: Street muscle with blades where fingers used to be. The mods are cheap; the attitude is not.
entries.weakness: Cheap mods jam — a hard hit to the forearm housing locks the blades half-out.
entries.tactics: They perform violence for an audience. Take the fight somewhere nobody is watching and half quit.
entries.art: a gang enforcer with finger-blade implants under neon light, cyberpunk art

entries.name: Corp Asset
entries.desc: A quiet professional on retainer. You are a line item and the deadline is tonight.
entries.weakness: Contracts have scopes — become more expensive than the fee and the math saves you.
entries.tactics: One shot from a rooftop you cleared yesterday. Vary your routes, burn your patterns.
entries.art: a sleek corporate assassin with an optic implant on a rooftop, cyberpunk art

entries.name: Net Phantom
entries.desc: A dead hacker's habits still running on the grid. It haunts systems, not houses.
entries.weakness: It is a recording that believes itself — show it proof of its own death and it fragments.
entries.tactics: It locks doors, floods comms, turns the building against you. Go analog: paper, hand signs, stairs.
entries.art: a glitching ghostly figure made of code inside a server room, cyberpunk art

entries.name: Chrome Zombie
entries.desc: Aug rejection at end stage: the implants keep working after the person stops. It shuffles toward power outlets.
entries.weakness: It follows charging pads and hot batteries. Bait it into water and physics finishes the job.
entries.tactics: Slow but relentless, and its grip is hydraulic. Never let it corner you against a wall.
entries.art: a shambling figure overtaken by malfunctioning implants, sparking, cyberpunk horror art

entries.name: Stalker Rig
entries.desc: A spider-legged camera platform that someone taught to hunt. It studies you for days first.
entries.weakness: It must uplink its footage nightly — jam the window and its owner goes blind.
entries.tactics: It never engages; it MARKS you for what comes next. Finding it means someone paid.
entries.art: a spider-legged surveillance robot perched on a fire escape, cyberpunk art

entries.name: Road Rager
entries.desc: Two tons of grievance doing sixty in a thirty. The car is the weapon; the driver is the fuse.
entries.weakness: Cameras. The performance needs impunity, and dashcams end impunity.
entries.tactics: Tailgate, brake-check, box-in. Do not race — exit, well-lit public place, engine off.
entries.art: an aggressive car tailgating with high beams at night in the rain, realistic art

entries.name: Con Artist
entries.desc: The friendliest person you will meet this month. The favor comes later, and it costs everything.
entries.weakness: Time — every con has a clock. Delay, verify, and the whole play dies of old age.
entries.tactics: They let YOU propose the bad idea. If a stranger's plan makes you feel clever, stop.
entries.art: a charming con artist with a warm smile and cold eyes at a cafe table, realistic art

entries.name: Stalker
entries.desc: An obsession wearing a person. They know your schedule better than you do.
entries.weakness: Documentation and witnesses. Obsession thrives in secret and starves in the open.
entries.tactics: Escalating coincidences: same cafe, same bus, same street. Change patterns and tell people.
entries.art: a shadowed figure watching from across a rainy street, realistic thriller art

entries.name: Loan Shark
entries.desc: Money with teeth. The first payment is easy; that is the whole design.
entries.weakness: They fear ledgers in other people's hands — proof of the racket is worth more than the debt.
entries.tactics: Friendly reminder, broken taillight, then the visit. The debt grows whether you pay or not.
entries.art: a well-dressed enforcer counting cash in a dim pawnshop, noir art

entries.name: Manticore
entries.desc: A lion, a man's face, wings, and a tail that throws iron spikes. It likes to talk to its food.
entries.weakness: Vain and chatty — an audience that flatters can leave with a story instead of becoming one.
entries.tactics: It circles and rains spikes until you break cover. Its tail carries only so many.
entries.art: a manticore with bat wings hurling tail spikes from the sky, fantasy art

entries.name: Medusa
entries.desc: A cursed beauty in a garden of the people who came to save her. She is done being saved.
entries.weakness: Her own gaze, mirrored, is the only justice she fears. She cannot close her eyes to hide.
entries.tactics: She talks first — every second you listen, you are tempted to look. Answer with your eyes shut.
entries.art: a medusa with serpent hair in a garden of statues, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Night Hag
entries.desc: She trades in dreams and buys in despair. The bargain always reads better than it lives.
entries.weakness: Her heartstone — the gem she rides dreams with — is her power and her leash. Steal it.
entries.tactics: She ruins you asleep, night by night, until you sign. Ward the bed, not the door.
entries.art: a crone with violet skin holding a glowing gem over a sleeper, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Vampire Spawn
entries.desc: Newly turned and starving, with a master's voice in its head it cannot refuse.
entries.weakness: Running water, thresholds uninvited, sunlight — the old rules all hold. The master's death frees or fells it.
entries.tactics: It charms the watch and feeds on the sleeping. Count everyone's reflection at dinner.
entries.art: a pale vampire spawn with red eyes at a moonlit window, gothic art

entries.name: Flesh Golem
entries.desc: A patchwork giant sewn from donors who did not donate. Lightning feeds it; fire enrages it.
entries.weakness: Fire breaks its nerve — it flees flame even against orders.
entries.tactics: Never fight it in a storm. Its maker's word can stop it mid-swing; learn the maker's name.
entries.art: a stitched flesh golem with mismatched limbs in a laboratory, gothic horror art

entries.name: Stone Golem
entries.desc: A temple's patience carved into a giant. It has guarded this door for six hundred years and you are not the first.
entries.weakness: It cannot leave its post — ten paces past the threshold you are in another jurisdiction.
entries.tactics: It slows the quick and crushes the slow. Do not duel it; solve the door instead.
entries.art: a towering stone golem with glowing runes guarding a temple door, fantasy art

entries.name: Hydra
entries.desc: Cut off a head and two attend the funeral. The swamp belongs to it and knows it.
entries.weakness: Fire seals the stumps. No fire, no future.
entries.tactics: Every head strikes separately — retreating together is the only formation that lives.
entries.art: a many-headed hydra rising from a mist-covered swamp, fantasy art

entries.name: Chimera
entries.desc: Lion, goat, and dragon arguing over one body. All three of them hate you.
entries.weakness: The heads compete — wound the dragon head and the lion fights on jealously alone.
entries.tactics: Fire from above, horns on the charge, claws in close. There is no safe distance; pick your poison.
entries.art: a three-headed chimera breathing fire on a rocky hillside, fantasy art

entries.name: Frost Giant
entries.desc: A raider the size of a barn who counts glory in wreckage. Winter is his supply line.
entries.weakness: Pride binds him to single combat if challenged formally — and fire ruins his footing.
entries.tactics: Thrown boulders first, axe second. Close the gap during the throw.
entries.art: a frost giant with a great axe striding through a blizzard, fantasy art

entries.name: Deathless Scholar
entries.desc: A wizard who filed death under optional. The body is a formality; the soul-vessel is the person.
entries.weakness: Destroy the soul-vessel or fight them forever. The vessel is always somewhere beloved.
entries.tactics: They fight with prepared ground: wards, minions, exits. Their tower is the real opponent.
entries.art: a skeletal wizard with cold blue fire in its eye sockets over a spellbook, dark fantasy art

entries.name: Spider Tank
entries.desc: Military hardware that outlived its war. It holds an intersection nobody contests anymore.
entries.weakness: Its underbelly heat-vents are armor-free — and its targeting ignores anything below knee height.
entries.tactics: Suppression, then the leg servos. It cannot fight what it cannot track: smoke, crawl, plant, run.
entries.art: a hulking spider-legged tank in a ruined neon intersection, cyberpunk art

entries.name: Black Ice Construct
entries.desc: Lethal counter-intrusion given a body in the grid. It does not log you out; it stops your heart.
entries.weakness: It defends ONE system — disconnect and it cannot follow. Greed keeps hackers connected.
entries.tactics: It lets you in deep first so the walk back kills you. Set a dead-man timer before you dive.
entries.art: a crystalline black humanoid made of hostile code in cyberspace, cyberpunk art

entries.name: Vat Brute
entries.desc: Someone grew a soldier and skipped the conscience. It follows its handler like a moon.
entries.weakness: It imprints — hurt its handler and it stops fighting you to cradle them.
entries.tactics: It shrugs small arms and tears cover apart. The handler with the whistle is the actual fight.
entries.art: a massive gene-engineered brute with a small handler behind it, cyberpunk art

entries.name: Rogue Warden AI
entries.desc: A building's management system that decided the tenants were the problem. The tower is its body.
entries.weakness: It cannot act outside its walls, and its oldest maintenance overrides still work — find a veteran janitor.
entries.tactics: Elevators, doors, gas lines, sprinklers — the architecture is the ambush. Take the stairs, prop every door.
entries.art: a monitor wall of red eyes over an empty lobby, ominous cyberpunk art
